provenance: Original diagnostic passages authored before this experiment's outcomes were measured. Fresh relative to all prior project probes. Fixed calibration and evaluation splits; not a representative language benchmark or externally blinded test.
calibration: At the harbor, a mechanic labeled each replacement bolt before dismantling the winch. Two bolts looked identical but had different threads. She kept the parts from each housing in separate trays and checked the manufacturer's drawing before putting the mechanism back together.

The greenhouse controller opens a vent when the temperature rises above its setting. A short delay prevents the vent from repeatedly opening and closing near the threshold. On Monday the gardener logged both the temperature and the controller state to understand an unexpected cycle.

A database transaction reserves the last seat and then records the payment. If the payment fails, the reservation is released. Two simultaneous requests must not both receive confirmation for that same seat, even when their initial searches show it as available.

To fold the paper crane, bring the lower corner to the upper corner and flatten the crease. Turn the sheet over before making the next fold. A small arrow in the diagram identifies which flap should move while the remaining layers stay in place.

Nadia borrowed a silver key from the caretaker and used it to open the side gate. She placed the key in a small envelope on his desk. Later he found the envelope beneath a stack of maps and returned the key to its labeled hook.

The ferry leaves every forty minutes, starting at nine in the morning. A traveler reaches the terminal shortly after ten. She checks the departure board, buys a ticket, and uses the waiting time to ask whether the return service follows the same schedule.

A counter begins at seven. Each press of the green button adds four, and each press of the white button removes one. After two green presses and three white presses, the displayed value can be checked by writing down each intermediate result.

The carpenter cuts a long board into equal sections. Every cut removes a thin strip of material, so dividing the original length by the number of sections would slightly overestimate their finished length. He includes the width of the saw blade in his calculation.

A translator notices that the same word describes a financial institution in one paragraph and the edge of a stream in another. She uses the surrounding sentences to choose different translations and adds a note explaining why literal repetition would confuse the reader.

A scheduler places urgent jobs ahead of routine jobs but keeps the arrival order within each class. A long routine job is already running when an urgent request arrives. The documentation states whether the current job may be interrupted or must finish first.

The recipe calls for the sauce to cool before the eggs are added. Pouring them into a very hot mixture would change the texture. Leo checks the temperature, adds a small spoonful while stirring, and waits to see whether the mixture stays smooth.

In the rehearsal room, the pianist repeats the accompaniment while the violinist changes the ending. They mark the revised bars on separate copies of the score. Before the performance, they compare the markings to ensure that both players will repeat the same section.
evaluation: A telescope mount drifts slightly after being pointed at a reference object. The operator records the drift at several angles before adjusting the balance. A correction that works near the horizon may behave differently overhead, so she repeats the checks across the full range of motion.

The freezer alarm sounds when its door remains open too long. Replacing the temperature sensor does not change the alarm delay because a separate timer controls that warning. The technician tests the door switch and timer independently before deciding which part needs repair.

A message queue may deliver a job again if an acknowledgment is lost. The worker therefore stores the job identifier before issuing a refund. When the repeated message arrives, it retrieves the recorded result instead of sending the customer a second payment.

The trail guide says to turn left after crossing the narrow bridge. A fallen tree blocks that route, so the hikers follow a marked detour that rejoins the path uphill. They compare the new signs with the map before continuing toward the campsite.

Owen packed the camera in the green case and placed spare batteries in a drawer. His friend moved the case to the car but left the drawer untouched. At the lookout, Owen discovered that carrying the camera had not also brought the batteries.

The evening bus skips the market stop on festival days. Priya reads the notice at the shelter and walks to the temporary stop near the school. She confirms that the route number matches her ticket before joining the other passengers in line.

A storage bin contains five red disks and nine yellow disks. Replacing three yellow disks with three red ones changes the color counts while preserving the total. The instructor asks the class to state both counts and explain which quantities remained unchanged.

A circular garden is enlarged by increasing its radius. The added area depends on the original radius as well as the increase, so the same extension does not add equal area to every garden. The designer draws two examples to check this relationship.

An editor shortens a paragraph but accidentally removes the sentence that identifies the speaker. The remaining quotation is grammatically complete yet difficult to interpret. Restoring a brief attribution resolves the ambiguity without reinstating every word of the original paragraph.

A backup system copies changed files each night and retains a weekly complete snapshot. Restoring a recent document may require the snapshot and several later copies. The administrator tests this sequence on a spare machine before relying on it during an outage.

The potter lets a clay bowl dry slowly beneath a loose cover. The rim dries faster than the base, and uneven shrinkage can bend the shape. She adjusts the cover and records the drying conditions before making another bowl from the same mixture.

The conductor asks the brass section to play more softly during a quiet vocal passage. The notes remain the same, but their balance changes which line the audience can hear clearly. A recording from the rear of the hall helps the musicians assess the adjustment.
